Rock Edit is a fast, private text and code editor: 100%% free and open (GPL-3.0), no ads, no accounts, no telemetry.
Your files never leave the device unless you explicitly use Storage Manager connections or the opt-in online code execution.
How do I open multiple files at once?

Open any file while the editor is on screen — it becomes a new tab. Use the + button or the “New tab” menu for empty tabs, long-press a tab to close it, and use “Close other tabs” to keep only the active one.
Where are my files? Can I browse folders?
Use “Open folder” to browse any folder the system file picker can reach, or “Open file” for a single document. The folder you picked is remembered for next time.
How do I work with FTP, SFTP or WebDAV servers?

Open the Storage manager from the main menu, add a connection (FTP, FTPS, SFTP or WebDAV) and browse the server. Files open in the editor like local ones; saving uploads them back. Passwords are stored encrypted with your device key store.
Can I restore my settings and data?
Yes — Settings › “Backup data (JSON)” writes a single file with your settings, recents, bookmarks, sessions and open tabs. “Restore data” reads it back on any device.

48 languages, detected from the file name: Kotlin, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Shell, SQL, JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, CSS and many more including Lua, Dart, Scala, PowerShell, Makefile, Dockerfile and LaTeX.
What about encodings and line breaks?
Files open with auto-detected encoding (15 charsets) and line break style (LF/CR/CRLF is preserved when saving). Use the “Reopen with encoding” and “Save with encoding” menus for full control.
How do I print or export a document?
Use “Print” from the editor menu — Android’s print service renders the document (and can save it as PDF) with any installed print service.

Optionally: “Run code” sends the current document to the public Piston service and shows stdout/stderr. It is off by default — enable it when prompted if you are comfortable with the code leaving the device.
